lines.1: 「Yo. Looks like you're oh for two.」
lines.3: 「She gave me one hell of a death glare on the stairs. Scary stuff.」
lines.4: 「I'd decided that if I ever have a daughter, I'll let her grow up free...」
lines.5: 「But now I think I'll be a real stickler about manners.」
lines.6: 「The thought of living under one roof after she turns out like that... Dad couldn't take it.」
lines.7: 「She's a beauty, but that personality is a disaster. Why not give up?」
lines.8: 「I'll keep trying for the rest of this week, at least.」
lines.9: 「You're more determined than you look, bastard.」
lines.10: 「Sure, she tore me apart again today, but I feel like I made some progress compared to yesterday.」
